Ramayana Film's Overseas Release, Oscar Hopes Highlighted

The upcoming film 'Ramayana' is set to have a significant overseas release, with reports indicating over 59,000 screens. The film's producer, Namit Malhotra, explained the rationale for the international release preceding the domestic one. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis expressed high hopes for the film, stating he would be disappointed if it did not receive an Oscar. The film is described as a mythological epic with a substantial budget.
